notes.title: Version 1.3.0 In Development!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/e38bcb2a0a38864d0d7dd2e9f7a155259765dcc6.png

Hello, Artists!
The wait is finally over.
Version 1.3.0 (Beta) – chock full of all kinds of new elements and adjustments – is going live!

This latest beta version features all sorts of cool new stuff: a weird new winding stick, the ability to designate stage colors, the addition of several new avatar-based settings, and more

[Applying the Update]
Steam Library
↓
Right-click “Soundart”
↓
Properties
↓
Beta
↓
Select “openBeta”

[Update Contents]

Additions

 New “octopus leg”-style stick (It’s super cute!)
 Adjustability intensity of avatar facial expression settings
 Avatar toggling feature
 Ability to adjust the degree to which your avatar spreads its elbows
 New avatar lip synching settings
 Settings for tweaking the colors for each individual stage
 Effects added to the PC-side view; track names are also now displayed when the song starts


Changes/Adjustments

 Angle of view adjusted for PC-side view camera; now prioritizes ease of view and avatar appearance over impact
 Camera angle and distance from subject also adjusted
 Display time for objects generated by comments when livestreaming has been greatly extended; also, number of objects appearing no longer affects rotation speed and display time. This makes for a more heightened sensation of supporting the player/being supported by the audience. No more feeling kinda lonely when the objects disappear right away.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug in which analysis data used for stage color changes was referencing a different location than the restart point.

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 In Development!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/e38bcb2a0a38864d0d7dd2e9f7a155259765dcc6.png

Dear Artists!
We are happy to announce that Mercury Studio, developer of SoundArt which is currently 20% off in the Steam Summer Sale, is working on the 1.3.0 version update of SoundArt.
This update will mainly address the visual side of things and many gameplay features will be improved upon.

Here are a few of the planned changes and additions: 
・Addition of settings for each stage, allow you to play in any color you choose.
・Addition of Avatar facial expression settings.
・Improvement of PC side visuals, allowing for the capture of post-editing quality video. 
・Overhaul stream sync feature so players and viewers alike feel more connected.
・Shocking new Sticks.

The update is not quite ready yet, but there will be a beta version before it goes fully live so we ask for your cooperation in testing the new version out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144460/SOUNDART/

notes.title: Build version 1.2.0 now live!
notes.notes:
[build 1.2.0]

Dear Artists!
Thank you for participating in the 1.2.0 beta test!

We have digested the data we collected from the beta and are pleased to announce the official release of version 1.2.0.
[previewyoutube=vDukqvs0Ft8;full][/previewyoutube]

This update brings features such as Gun sticks, improved stage music creation and a favorites feature for your music.

The update also brings several adjustments and bug fixes and makes for a further immersive gameplay experience!

[Changes from version 1.2.0b1]

Added:

Favorites function for files and folders.
Title screen prompt to put on your headset. 
Added 3 preset songs.


Changes: 

Adjusted each difficulty level slightly.
Made the flower strike window slightly more forgiving.
Changed the Gun stick energy UI position.


Bug fixes: 

Fixed bug that was causing comment sync problems due to not getting the correct time from youtube.
Fixed bug that prevented album art from showing when there was a mix of files and folders in the same folder.
Fixed bug that was causing the Sword sticks to flip over. 
Regarding stage music settings, fixed a bug that was causing sweep and combo hit strength to affect hit register length. 
 Regarding stage music settings, fixed a bug that was causing user saved settings to not load correctly.

notes.title: Build v1.1.2 (beta) Update.
notes.notes:
Dear Artists!
Thank you for all of the helpful feedback on the previous update.

There were a lot of comments on the distance between the sticks and the Flower.

The previous distance increased the distance between the sticks and the flower in the hopes that the Notes would be more visible, however this has resulted in an increase in miss hits.

Saying that, there are a lot of comments saying the Notes are indeed easier to follow now so we are looking for an effective middle ground between the two issues.

To gather user feedback on this we will be holding an open beta to see how you, the users, feel. You can join in by selecting the “openBeta” option from the beta tab  in properties.

We look forward to your comments regarding Note visibility and the sense of distance from the stick to the Flower.

build1.1.2 beta1

Update Details：

 Brought Note spawn point closer.
 Notes now spiral as they approach.
 Reduced Note size some slightly.
 Brought the Note hit position in towards the center.
 Reduced overall Note speed.
 Reduced Flower size slightly and brought it closer to the player.
 Changed the “thrust” Note design.
 Minor adjustment to hit effect.

notes.title: Build v1.1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Artists!
Sorry this update took so long.

Taking in all the comments and recommendations from you all after launch, we decided it was better to release a bigger update instead of releasing a series of small patches.

This update aims to improve the ease of use, gameplay and visuals of the game.
We put extra effort into the “flower” petals where you hit the Notes. We are sure you will find it even more visually appealing than before!

[previewyoutube=-fBzBKPcihA;full][/previewyoutube]

Update Summary: 

 Improved gameplay to feel more exhilarating and impactful.
 Made the background graphics easier on the eyes, while maintaining its beauty.

Details: 

 Increased distance between player and the Flower.
 Extended hitbox of sticks to accommodate above change.
 Changed Flower design.
 Adjusted the colour scheme, layout and design of background structures.
 Upgraded the Blossom and Urban backgrounds.
 Adjusted size of Notes and their flight paths.
 Adjusted speed of notes.
 Changed the destruction animation of Notes.
 Changed it so the reaction of the petals depends on how hard they were hit.
 Adjusted hit detection coding so it feels more real.
 Decrrwsed fog concentration.
